requirement: A command is accepted only when pre.ready and action.valid are both 1 at a rising edge outside reset; an offered but unaccepted command must be held unchanged until handshake or reset, otherwise assumption violation.
assumptions: command offered during SW_RST is a driver protocol violation

requirement: TX words handshake on pre.tx_ready & tx_valid; offered words must hold until accepted or reset.

Reserved speed 3 and Dual/Quad bidirectional segments are blocking assumption violations; legal dummy (no read, no write) segments are recorded as unresolved scope-unsupported and suspend serial checking until reset.
assumptions: dummy cycle count semantics are not in the supplied excerpts, so dummy segments are unsupported

requirement: Each TX byte at the device sampling edge (leading edge if CPHA=0, trailing if CPHA=1) equals the next enabled byte of accepted words in increasing lane order 0..3 (lane i = bits 8i+7:8i, enabled by tx_be[i]; registered amendment spi_host_core_public_contract_v2_lsb supersedes the MSB-lane-first reading of theory 698-702, retained as historical conflict), bits MSB-first within a byte, skipping be=0 bytes; at segment end the rest of a partially consumed word is discarded (flush).
assumptions: Dual/Quad: higher-numbered SD line carries more significant bit (lane order not stated in excerpts)
TX word accepted at the same edge as a sampling edge is not yet available

requirement: No SCK edge consumes a TX byte when no accepted data is available; TX starvation must pause SCK with CSB held.

Received bytes b0..b3 are packed into bits 7:0,15:8,23:16,31:24 (registered amendment v2_lsb per theory 412-419,483, registers RXDATA, programmer guide; supersedes theory 735-738 which is retained as historical conflict), a word emitted every 4 bytes and at segment end, partial words zero-padded in unused HIGH lanes; words delivered in order without loss or duplication, never before their last byte is sampled.
assumptions: host samples SD on the CPHA sampling edge (FULLCYC=1: CLKDIV+1 clocks later); an RX bit is only judged if action.sd is stable over the sample window, else unresolved

requirement: Standard: host never drives SD[1] at sampling edges; TX segments enable used lines; Dual/Quad RX segments do not drive used lines.

Exactly the commanded CSB line is low during SCK edges; CSB never deasserts mid-segment; after CSAAT=0 CSB deasserts before the next segment; after CSAAT=1 CSB stays low unless a detected next segment (accepted, or stably offered with valid=1 while ready=0) changes CSID or configuration; fields with valid=0 never permit release; never both CSB low.
assumptions: no deadline imposed on CSB deassertion after CSAAT=0

requirement: Minimum CSB fall to first SCK edge >= (CSNLEAD+1)*(CLKDIV+1) clocks, last SCK edge to CSB rise >= (CSNTRAIL+1)*(CLKDIV+1) (previous config), CSB idle >= (CSNIDLE+1)*(CLKDIV+1) (new config), SCK half period >= CLKDIV+1; minima only.
assumptions: ticks measured in clk cycles from observed pin transitions

requirement: SCK is at CPOL level at CSB assertion and before the first edge; edges alternate leading/trailing consistent with CPOL. An SCK change while all CSB are idle and no segment is in progress is an idle-level setup (not a payload edge) only if it moves SCK to the CPOL of an accepted pending segment; otherwise spurious_sck.
ACTIVE is high while a started segment is mid-transfer.
assumptions: no exact-cycle deadline for ACTIVE rise/fall

requirement: While rst_n=0 all CSB are deasserted; all queued state and pending data are discarded; post-reset traffic must carry no stale payload.
Driver must observe ACTIVE=0 and CSB idle before releasing SW_RST (else assumption violation); post-release traffic must carry no stale payload. Stronger in-stall behaviour is recorded as unresolved.
assumptions: TXQD/RXQD not observable at core pins
RX words delivered during SW_RST not judged

requirement: Event windows (tx_starvation_resume, rx_backpressure_resume, partial_word_then_next_transaction [held_cs|csid_change], reset_abort_restart [hardware|software]) pass only if trigger, resolution and full segment completion (serial beats, payload, words delivered, CSB rise when CSAAT=0) occur with no failures or assumption violations in the window; otherwise fail/blocked/pending.
assumptions: event completion is not coverage or equivalence evidence
